args.subject: Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech, David!
args.body:
Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! I'm Emma Johnson, and I just wanted to send you a warm welcome as you join our team next week.

We're thrilled to have you on board in the marketing department. I know there's a lot to get up to speed on in your first days, so please don't hesitate to reach out if there's anything I can help with — whether it's setting up your accounts, getting oriented with the team, or just finding your way around.

Looking forward to working with you!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
